summary: This directory acts as the root entry point for the entire application, serving as the primary bridge between internal core business features and external UI-facing exports. It aggregates and exposes the design system, business workflows, and domain-driven components for consumption.
responsibilities: Expose core application functionality and UI components via a unified API
Aggregate feature-level business logic and state management
Provide a centralized access point for the design system
Maintain the architectural boundary between domain models and UI implementation
relationships: The directory serves as the public interface for the underlying features and UI layers.
Internal domain entities and business rules are exposed to external consumers through these centralized exports.
The root structure orchestrates the relationship between the UI component library and the business logic defined in core features.
designDecisions: Use of barrel files to simplify imports and provide a clean public API
Centralization of application entry points to enforce decoupling
Facade pattern to hide internal implementation details of core features from external consumers
